lab.name: Lab
lab.about: Professor Chosen's lab (his assistant Hazel does the work). Its board sells unlocks for Research.

station.name: Skyline Station
station.about: The station where runs start. Upgrades for Crests take runs to new lands.

ranch.name: Ranch
ranch.about: The barn by the farm patch. Each level trains more Billies, higher.

genebank.name: Gene Bank
genebank.about: A vault of Genes. Sequence a Billie's parts into the library, then splice them on for DNA. Each level splices more slots, more steadily.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.about: Where robots will be built and refitted. Coming later.
